replication.target_description: Study 1, categorical nostalgia versus control song condition predicting positive-valence ratings, rather than number of positive emotions predicting nostalgia.

n.sample_role: Participants (clusters); 2,234 song-level observations in the final paired-song analysis.
n.exclusions: 14 removed for improper responses; 172 without appropriately matched control songs excluded. Only complete nostalgia/control song pairs retained.

notes: Known test mismatch: replication measures positive valence and reverses the predictor/outcome roles relative to original. Narrative verdict concerns context-level findings collectively. Replication p is Bonferroni-adjusted; coefficient is not standardized. Original analytic n left null because the study-level total is not explicitly established for the selected test; no n derived from degrees of freedom.
